entities.name: Supplied adenylate kinase
observations: 252 aa protein with calculated molecular mass 28.21 kDa and theoretical pI 8.21.
Exact sequence hash match to UniProt A5E598, a reviewed adenylate kinase from Lodderomyces elongisporus.
Contains Pfam ADK domain PF00406 at residues 42-228 and ADK_lid PF05191 at residues 165-200.
Also matches the ATP-binding-related AAA_17 profile PF13207 at residues 43-175.
Curated homolog annotation assigns EC 2.7.4.3 adenylate kinase activity and monomeric subunit organization.
